fixed: 2026-11-01, before any B0/B1/B2-vs-experiment statistic was computed
decided_by: Claude, within the plan; candidate groups and descriptor options below are not user wording

direction.experiment: dG kcal/mol, lower = stronger (BRD4 manifests/brd4_measurements.csv, Hou manifests/hou2011_table_s1.csv)
direction.scores: lower = predicted stronger, compared directly with dG; positive rho = agreement

methods.B1_start_default: scores/start_default (score_smallmol_start.py): one frame, minimised start, frozen default grid sized on that frame; no replica SE
methods.B2_md_default: BRD4 reports/brd4_round1_replicas.csv (3 x (0,5] ns); Hou reports/hou_ranking_20261030/samples.csv (6 x (0,10] ns, 39 online + 3 offline-recovered replicas); replica time means, equal-weight average, SE = sd(replica means)/sqrt(n)
methods.B2_md_h04_sensitivity: BRD4 only: reports/brd4_h0.4_replicas.csv, same frames as B2_md_default. Hou h0.4 exists only for 3 x (0,5] ns, not the 6 x 10 ns budget, so it is not compared

descriptor_diagnostics.n_rotatable: RDKit CalcNumRotatableBonds(mol, NumRotatableBondsOptions.Strict), hydrogens kept as in the sdf
descriptor_diagnostics.formal_charge: RDKit GetFormalCharge on the sdf (BRD4: sources/brd4/sdf; Hou: prepared/hou/<s>/ph74_gaff2/ligand_in.sdf, pH 7.4 model)
descriptor_diagnostics.partial_charge_sum: sum of simulated topology partial charges (manifests/*_inputs.csv ligand_charge)
descriptor_diagnostics.use: raw values with their own sign; Spearman/Kendall against dG reported as diagnostics only; no sign flip from experiment, no weights, no selection of best combination
descriptor_diagnostics.not_computed: contact/burial descriptors: no existing definition in the package (plan §4.2 'only if already defined')

hou_a1_a4_same_series.role: primary Hou comparison (same chemical series; not verified same assay conditions)

brd4_itc6_cross_source_exploratory.role: ITC labels from four papers; cross-source, exploratory

brd4_same_source_pairs.role: same paper per pair; same assay conditions not yet checked (P2)

excluded.BRD4-1: non-binder (inactive at 250 uM), no exact dG; scores listed, no pair statistics until the P2 label audit
excluded.BRD4-2: no saturation (32% inhibition at 250 uM), no exact dG; same handling as BRD4-1

statistics.per_group_and_method: Spearman rho (main), Kendall tau-b, concordant/discordant/tied pairs, two-sided exact permutation p over all label permutations (rank_hou_sampling.exact_statistics); undefined when a method has no variance in the group
statistics.size_dependence: Spearman rho between each method's score and score_size within the group
statistics.pairs: every pair in each group: experimental order, each method's difference and agreement; B2 difference / combined replica SE (sqrt(SE_i^2+SE_j^2)) listed as a ratio, no threshold; whether B2 reverses the B1 order
statistics.not_done_here: no resampling: B1 has a single structure (no replica distribution is invented); Hou B2 sampling/candidate resampling already in reports/hou_ranking_20261030/ranking.json; BRD4 resampling belongs to P2

reproduction_check: Hou B2_md_default rho/tau/pairs must equal reports/hou_ranking_20261030/ranking.json
